<div class="table-responsive-xl table-responsive-md u-datatable" id="table-overflow">
    <table id="table-condition-search" class="js-freeze-header table loose-table">
        <thead>
        <tr class="bg-light text-secondary loose-table align-middle">
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-1">
                <div class="bg-light">
                    <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active pl-0"></div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-1 align-middle">
                <div class="bg-light">
                    <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active pl-0">
                        <div class="text-nowrap">#</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>


            <th width="15%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center text-secondary">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        关键词
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p style=&quot;&quot;>买家通过搜索该关键词后对ASIN产生了点击（和转化）</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>并且该ASIN是这个关键词的搜索结果下，点击量最高的3个ASIN之一</p><p style=&quot;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;&quot;>数据来源于亚马逊ABA数据的关键词搜索报告</p><p style=&quot;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;&quot;>默认按照关键词的搜索排名升序排列，搜索排名越高排序越靠前<br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/aba-reverse-for-beginners&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>亚马逊ABA报告详细解读</a></p>'></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-1 align-middle">
                <div class="bg-light">
                    <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active " >
                        <div class="text-nowrap">转化效果
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>指的是产品在不同关键词的下各种转化效果，可通过亚马逊ABA数据进行准确性验证</p><p><br></p><p><b>主要的转化类型及其定义如下所示：</b></p><p>转化优质词：指ABA数据中转化共享≥5%且周排名属于区间R₁的流量词 或 ABA数据中转化共享≥10%且周排名属于区间R₂的流量词，<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>即转化较高且搜索排名靠前的流量词</span></p><p>转化平稳词：指ABA数据中最近2周转化共享≥3%且周排名属于区间R₃的流量词，<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>即转化效果、搜索排名中等但近期较稳定的流量词</span></p><p>转化流失词：指ABA数据中上周有转化（转化共享&gt;0%）、本周无转化（转化共享=0%），且周排名属于区间R₄的流量词，<span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>即转化逐渐流失、且搜索排名靠后的流量词</span></p><p>无效曝光词：指ABA数据中有点击记录，但没有转化</p><p>Not Availlable：指的是不满足上述任一条件的关键词</p><p><br></p><p><b>关键词周排名的区间范围（按照各站点的市场体量大小进行划分）：</b></p><p>R₁：美国∈[1, 10000]，德国/英国/日本∈[1, 2000]，西班牙/法国/意大利/加拿大∈[1, 1000]</p><p>R₂：美国∈[1, 50000]，德国/英国/日本∈[1, 10000]，西班牙/法国/意大利/加拿大∈[1, 5000]</p><p>R₃：美国∈[1, 500000]，德国/英国/日本∈[1, 100000]，西班牙/法国/意大利/加拿大∈[1, 50000]</p><p>R₄：美国∈(500000, ∞]，德国/英国/日本∈(100000, ∞]，西班牙/法国/意大利/加拿大∈(50000, ∞]</p>'></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
                <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-1 align-middle">
                    <div class="bg-light">
                        <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active " >
                            <div class="text-nowrap">   
                                    周搜索量
                                    <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>指一个自然周，比如2023第19周(05/07~05/13)，该关键词在亚马逊站内的搜索总次数<br></p>'></span>
                                </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </th>
            <th width="15%" scope="col" class="mobile-field-hide align-middle" style="max-width:140px">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        排名趋势
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>以周/月为单位的关键词搜索排名趋势</p><p>鼠标悬浮到趋势图上，可以看到各时间段内的具体排名及相对上一周期的排名变化</p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p><p>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-trends&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过搜索趋势判断买家需求？</a><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p>'></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>

            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <a href="javascript:" order-field="searchRank" class="order-field th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary pl-0 pr-0" >
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        排名
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>该关键词每周（或每月）的Search Frequency Rank（ABA数据的关键词搜索频率排名）<br></p>'></span>
                    </div>
                    <span class='order-span fas order-span-active fa-angle-down u-datatable__thead-icon ml-1'></span>
                        </a>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle pl-3">
                <a href="javascript:" order-field="searchRankGrowthValue" class="order-field th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary pl-0 pr-0">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        
                                周变化量
                                <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>指该关键词本周的搜索排名相对于上一周的变化值；正数(绿色)为排名上升，负数(红色)为排名下降</p><p><br></p><p>如上周排名为第43名，本周排名为第21名，则周变化量为+22，表示本周搜索排名上升了22位</p><p>如上周排名为第7名，本周排名为第23名，则变化量为-16，表示本周搜索排名下降了16位</p>'></span>
                            </div>
                    <span  class="order-span fas fa-angle-down u-datatable__thead-icon ml-1" ></span>
                        </a>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-4 align-middle">
                <a href="javascript:" order-field="searchRankGrowthRate" class="order-field th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary pl-0 pr-0">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        
                                周变化率
                                <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>指该关键词本周的搜索排名相对于上一周的变化百分比；正数(绿色)为排名上升，负数(红色)为排名下降</p><p><br></p><p>计算规则：(周变化量/上周排名)*100%</p><p>例如上周排名为第2名，本周排名为第9名，周变化量为-7，则周变化率为-7/2=-350%</p>'></span>
                            </div>
                    <span  class="order-span fas fa-angle-down u-datatable__thead-icon ml-1" ></span>
                        </a>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-3 align-middle">
                <div class="bg-light">
                    <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active " >
                        <div class="text-nowrap">点击占比
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>数据来源于亚马逊ABA数据的关键词搜索报告</p><p>某一周或某个自然月内关键词下该ASIN的点击量与关键词总点击量的百分比</p><p>（每周更新上周的数据，每月月初更新上个月的数据）</p><p><br></p><p>比如买家在11.07-11.13期间搜索关键词christmas tree后，共产生了1000个点击</p><p>其中产品A的点击有56个，那么关键词christmas tree下A的点击共享就是56/1000=5.6%</p>'></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="pl-3 align-middle">
                <div class="bg-light">
                    <div class="th d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center text-secondary active " >
                        <div class="text-nowrap">转化占比
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>数据来源于亚马逊ABA数据的关键词搜索报告</p><p>某一周或某个自然月内该关键词下该ASIN的转化数与关键词总转化数的百分比</p><p>（每周更新上周的数据，每月月初更新上个月的数据）</p><p><br></p><p>比如买家在11.07-11.13期间搜索关键词christmas tree后，共产生了400个购买</p><p>其中产品A的购买有27个，那么关键词christmas tree下A的转化共享就是27/400=6.75%</p>'></span>
                        </div>

<script>
    // 渲染tips
    var initIconToTips = function () {
        $('.icon-to-tips').each(function (index, ele) {
            var $ele = $(ele);
            var website = $ele.attr('data-station-website');
            var station = $ele.attr('data-station-code');
            var marketId = $ele.attr('data-station-marketId');
            var keywords = $ele.attr('data-keywords');
            if (keywords) {
                keywords.replace(/&/g, '%26')
            }
            var tips = "关键词挖掘 <a class='no-decoration lighter' href='/v3/keyword-miner?marketId=" + marketId + "&q=" + keywords
                + "' target='_blank'><span class='iconfont icon-to_amazon small ml-1'></span></a><br/>"
                + "查流量来源 <a class='no-decoration lighter' href='/v3/reversing/sources?marketId=" + marketId + "&asin=" + keywords
                + "' target='_blank'><span class='iconfont icon-to_amazon small ml-1'></span></a>";
            $ele.attr('data-tips', tips);
        });
        $('.icon-to-tips').each(tips_popover)
    };
    $(document).ready(function () {
        initIconToTips();
        // 关键词翻译
        function saveBtnEv(){
            $(".editTranslation").on("click",'.save-btn-event',function () {
                let param = {
                    'station':$("input[name='station']").val(),
                    'keywords':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywords-save').val(),
                    'keywordCn':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywordCn-val').val()
                };
                $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',true);
                let _this = $(this);
                $.ajax({
                    type: "post",
                    url: "/v2/keyword/updateTranslation",
                    data: param,
                    cache: false,
                    async: false,
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function (data) {
                        $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',false);
                        if (data.error){
                            alert(data.error);
                        }else {
                            // window.location.replace(location.href);   
                            _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.span-keywords-transport').text(param.keywordCn);
                            _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
        
        }
        function showEdit(){
            $('.edit-translation').on('click','.edit-btn-event',function(){
                $('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
                $(this).parent('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","inline")
            })
        }
        saveBtnEv()
        showEdit()
    })
</script>

            <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 d-flex ml-4">
                <div>
                    {{if item.asinObj && item.asinObj.imageUrl}}
                    <img src="{{= item.asinObj.imageUrl}}" width="40"
                        onerror="javascript:this.src='../../../assets-v2/img/image_loadfail_cn.png';">
                    {{else}}
                    <img src="/assets-v2/img/image_loading_cn.png" width="40">
                    {{/if}}
                </div>
                <div class="ml-1">
                    <a href="{{= item.url}}" class="link-dark link-title" style="border-bottom: none;">
                        {{if item.asinObj && item.asinObj.title}}
                        <div class="ellipsis" title="{{= item.asinObj.title}}" style="max-width:320px">
                            {{= item.asinObj.title}}
                        </div>
                        {{else item.keywords}}
                        <div class="ellipsis" title="{{= item.keywords}}" style="max-width:240px;">
                            {{= item.keywords}}
                        </div>
                        {{else}}
                        <div class="ellipsis wd100" title="默认查询" style="text-overflow: inherit;">
                            默认查询
                        </div>
                        {{/if}}
                    </a>
                    <div class="mt-1">
                        <span class="flag-icon flag-icon-${item.market.countryCode.toLowerCase()}"></span>
                        <span class="break-all text-9FA3A8" style="font-size: 10px;">{{= item.asin}}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </td>
            <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 text-center">
                {{if item.free == 'Y' }}
                <div class="td text-31C993" style="text-decoration: underline;" data-tips="查询结果未完整展示">{{= item.results}}
                </div>
                {{else}}
                <div class="td text-31C993">{{= item.results}}</div>
                {{/if}}
            </td>
            <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 text-center mr-4">
                <div class="mw80">${moment(item.queryTime).format('YYYY-MM-DD')}</div>
                </td>
        </tr>
        {{/each}}
    </script>
    <script id="querylog-tbody-noitem-tmp" type="text/template">
        <tr>
            <td colspan="4" style="border-bottom: none;">
                <div class="align-center text-muted" style="text-align: center;min-height:250px;padding-top: 100px;" >
                    <div class="align-center querylog-div-noitems">暂无查询记录！</div>
                </div>
            </td>
        </tr>
    </script>
    <script id="querylog-tbody-loading" type="text/template">
        <tr>
            <td colspan="4" style="border-bottom: none;">
                <div class="align-center text-muted" style="text-align: center;min-height:250px;padding-top: 100px;" >
                    <div class="align-center querylog-div-noitems">加载中......</div>
                </div>
            </td>
        </tr>
    </script>
    <script id="querylog-pg-nv-tmp" type="text/template">
        <div class="col-12 col-md-12">
            <div class="row no-gutters align-items-baseline">
                <div class="col-12 col-md-auto flex-grow-0 text-center text-md-left">
                <span class="text-secondary text-nowrap ml-4">
                    {{if pg.items && pg.items.length < pg.pageSize}}
                        <span class="text-primary">${pg.startIndex + 1}-{{= pg.startIndex + pg.items.length}}</span>
                    {{else}}
                        <span class="text-primary">${pg.startIndex + 1}-{{= pg.startIndex + pg.pageSize}}</span>
                    {{/if}}
                    /{{if pg.totalCount && pg.totalCount >= 1000}} 1000+ {{else}} {{= pg.totalCount}} {{/if}}
                </span>
                </div>
                <div class="col-12 col-md-auto mt-3 mt-md-0">
                    <ul class="pagination m-0 ml-2 justify-content-center justify-content-md-start">
                        
                        {{each(index,page) pg.pages}}
                        {{if index < 5 }}
                        <li class="page-item {{if page == pg.currentPage}}active{{/if}}" data-page="{{= page}}" ><a class="page-link" href="javascript:;">{{= page}}</a></li>
                        {{/if}}
                        {{/each}}
                        </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </script>

<style>
     .tag-asin{
      margin: 6px 0 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      height: 30px;
      border: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      background-color: rgb(71, 80, 99);
      padding: 0 10px;
      line-height: 30px;
      display: inline-block;
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .input-tag-asins-box{
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      width: 96%;
      padding-top: 10px;
      padding-bottom: 10px;
      border: 1px solid #fb8c1e;
      border-radius: 4px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-right: 80px;
    }
    #dialog-batch-input-asin{
      flex:1;
      border-color: transparent;
      min-width: 180px;
    }
    #dialog-batch-input-asin:focus{
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }
    .asin-del{
      color: #fff;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-style: normal;
      padding-left: 8px;
      font-size: 15px !important;
      transform: scale(0.7);
    }
    .button-box{
      display: flex;
      justify-content: end;
      width: 96%;
    }
    .btn-del-asin-list{
      background-color: #b1b4b8;
      color: #fff;
      border-color: #b1b4b8;
    }
    .btn-asin-batch{
      padding: 9px 22px !important;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .grid-is-active i{
      color: #697183 !important;
    }
    .grid-is-liebiao{
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .input-batch-asin-content{
      position: relative;
    }
    .monthly-asin-grid-liebiao-btn {
      width: 64px;
      height: 32px;
      background: #FFFFFF;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid #E6E8EC;
      position: absolute;
      top:12px;
      right: 50px;
      color: #E6E8EC;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .monthly-asin-grid-liebiao-btn span {
        display: block;
        line-height: 33px;
        text-align: center;
        min-width: 32px;
    }

    .monthly-asin-grid-liebiao-btn i {
        color: #bec2cc;
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .monthly-asin-grid-liebiao-btn span:hover,
    .monthly-asin-grid-liebiao-btn span.ischecked{
        /* background-color: #eff1f5; */
        color: #bec2cc;
    }
    .modal.show .modal-dialog{
        transform: translateY(80px) !important;
    }
    @media (min-width: 992px){
        .modal-lg {
            max-width: 910px !important;
        }
    }
</style>

<script>
    // 初始化 popover
    function fInitPopover($targets) {
        $targets.each(function (index, ele) {
            var $ele = $(ele);
            $ele.popover({ 'trigger': 'manual', delay: { show: 500 } }).on('mouseenter', function () {
                var _this = this;   // 这里的this触发的dom,需要存起来 否则在下面 .popover的逻辑中this会变为弹出的dom
                $(this).popover("show");
                $(".popover").on("mouseleave", function () {
                    $(_this).popover('hide');
                });
            }).on('mouseleave', function () {
                var _this = this;
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!$(".popover:hover").length) {
                        $(_this).popover("hide");
                    }
                }, 300);
            });
        });
    }
    function reduceTheNumberOfExport($target) {
        //减少导出次数
        try {
            var export_remain_num = $target.attr('export_remain_num');
            if (export_remain_num) {
                var num = parseInt(export_remain_num, 10),
                tips = "您今日的导出次数已使用完，请待明日恢复次数后，再导出";
                if ("com.iyunya.rank.dao.vo.ClientSearchVO@354884e0" === "" || ("S" === "G" && "N" !== "Y")){
                    tips = '您是免费用户，<a href="/cn/price" style="border-bottom:1px dashed #FB8C1E" target="_blank">升级套餐</a>后即可导出';
                    num = 1;
                }
                num = num - 1;
                if (num <= 0) {
                    num = 0;
                    $target[0].classList.add('disabled')
                }else{
                    var temp = $target.attr('data-template');
                    if (temp) {
                        tips = temp.replace(/#num#/ig, num);
                    }
                }
                $target.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
                $target.attr('title', tips);
                $target.attr('data-original-title', tips);
                $target.popover('dispose');
                $target.each(tips_popover);
            }
        } catch (error) {

        }
        //减少导出次数
    }

        }
        $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
        $target.popover('dispose');
        $target.each(tips_popover);  
        $target.popover("show")
    })

        }
        $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
        $target.popover('dispose');

    function newbieLocalStorage(newbie_switch, beginner_guide) {
        newbie_switch = newbie_switch ? newbie_switch : false;

        function handleSceneTips(){
            if ($('#scene_tips').length < 1) return false;
            var jsonStr = $.trim($('#scene_tips').html());
            if(jsonStr && "null" != jsonStr){
                var sceneTip = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsRead('+ id +","+ uri +')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {
                                $this.popover("show")
                        }, 0);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        handleSceneTips();

            if ($('#set_of_scene_tips').length < 1) return false;
            let jsonStr = $.trim($('#set_of_scene_tips').html());
            if(jsonStr && "null" != jsonStr){
                let sceneTips = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let sceneTip = sceneTips[tipIndex];
                if(!sceneTip) return false
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let nextTipIndex = tipIndex+1;
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsReadNext('+ id +","+ uri +","+nextTipIndex+')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {
                                $this.popover("show")
                        }, 0);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        handleSetSceneTips()
    // 获取导出次数
    function getRemainExportNum() {
        $("button.remainExportNum-btn").each(function() {
            const $btn = $(this);
            let module = $btn.attr('data-module') || 'NEBD';
            console.log(module, 'module')
            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: '/v2/common/remain-export-num/' + module,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: (result) => {
                    if (result.code === 'OK') {
                        let num = result.data * 1 + 1;
                        $btn.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                        reduceTheNumberOfExport($btn);
                    }
                },
                error: (xhr, status, err) => {
                    console.error(module + '剩余次数请求失败:', err);
                }
            });
        });
    }

</script>

<script>
    function fInitFirebaseTopics() {
        const system = "SS_CN".toLowerCase();
        const role = "N".toUpperCase();
        const cqml = "STANDARD".toUpperCase();
        const city = "浙江杭州".toUpperCase();
        if (role === 'R' || role === 'Y') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-admin');
        else if (role === 'SP') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-super-agent');
        else if (role === 'S') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-sub');
        else window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-parent');

        if (system.indexOf('cn') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-CN');
        else if (system.indexOf('jp') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-JP');
        else if (system.indexOf('en') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-EN');
        // 推送注册国家
        if (system.indexOf('cn') < 0) city && city.indexOf('|') > 0 && window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(city.substr(0, 2));

        if (cqml != null && cqml.length > 1) {
            let _ml = "ML-" + cqml;
            window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(_ml);
            window.FIREBASE_TOPIC_MEMBER_LEVEL = _ml;
        }
    }fInitFirebaseTopics();
</script>
<script>
    function axisPointerFormatter(params) {
        var value = Number(params.value);
        if (isNaN(value)) {
            return params.value;
        }
        if (value <= 1.0) {
            return value.toFixed(2);
        } else {
            return value.toFixed(0);
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    function trackClarityEvent(eventName, tags = {}) {
        if(!window.clarity) return

        Object.keys(tags).forEach(key => {
            window.clarity("set", key, String(tags[key]))
        })

        window.clarity("event", eventName)
    }

<script>
    // 显示弹窗
    var currentUri = '/v2/aba/reverse/search';
    // 中文环境
    var isZh = true;
    // 路由命中
    var isMatchedCurrentUri = ['/v2/market-research', '/v2/keyword-research', '/v2/aba/reverse/search'].some(s => s.indexOf(currentUri) > -1);
    // 登录成功
    var isLogin = Number('435722') > 0;
    // 免费会员
    var isFreeMember = 'S' === 'G';

    // 是否是管理员
    var isAdmin = ['Y', 'A2', 'R'].includes('N')

    console.log('路由命中：', isMatchedCurrentUri, ' 是否登录：', isLogin, ' 是否为免费会员（简单判断）：', isFreeMember, ' 是否为管理员：', isAdmin)

    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }

    // 路由命中、且已登录
    if (isLogin && isMatchedCurrentUri) {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/v3/api/popup/push-status',
            method: 'get',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (res) {
                // 5分钟拦截
                let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
                let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
                if(!flag) {
                    return;
                }
                // 使用新的判断逻辑
                openDirectionalWechatModal(res);
                return;

                var showWechatDialog = res && (res.data || false)
                if (showWechatDialog) {
                    $.ajax({
                        url: '/v3/api/client/valid-pay-status',
                        method: 'GET',
                        dataType: 'json',
                        success: function(payStatusRes) {
                            $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                            let isAdmin = false
                            if(isAdmin){
                                $.ajax({
                                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                                    method: 'GET',
                                    dataType: 'json',
                                    success:function(qrData){
                                        // 有效付费用户
                                        if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        } else {
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        }
                                    }
                                })
                            }else{
                                if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                    $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                } else {
                                    $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})

                                }
                            }

                           
                        }
                    })
                }
            }
        })
    }

    // 新的打开弹窗逻辑
    function openDirectionalWechatModal(res) {
        if (res) {
            var data = res.data || {};
            var showWechatDialog = data.allowPush === 'Y' && ['Y', 'N'].includes(data.paidUser);

            if (showWechatDialog) {
                $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                $.ajax({
                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                    method: 'GET',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success:function(qrData){
                        // 有效付费用户
                        if (data.paidUser === 'Y') {
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        } else if (data.paidUser === 'N') {
                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        }
                    }
                })

                        
             
            }
        }
    }

    // 关闭弹窗
    $('[data-directional-wechat-close]').click(function () {
        $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('body').css({ overflow: '' })
    })
</script>

<div class="modal fade survey-view-modal" id="surveyViewModal" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" data-backdrop="static"
     data-keyboard="false" aria-labelledby="myModalLabel" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0 auto;overflow:hidden">
    <div class="modal-dialog survey-dialog-modal">
        <input type="hidden" id="surveyId" />
        <input type="hidden" id="answer" />
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header align-items-center">
                <div class="h4 modal-title" id="myModalLabel">
                    问卷调查 - 倾听您的声音，改进您的体验
                </div>
                <button id="btn-modal-close" type="button" class="close"> <span
                        class="iconfont icon-close-icon"></span></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body d-flex justify-content-center scroll-show-auto" id="surveyContent">
            </div>
            <div class="footer-box">
                <button id="submitSurvey" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">
                    <i class="iconfont icon-icon_function_tijiaoshenhe mr-1"></i>我要交卷</button>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    let url="";
    let surveyCodeIn = "";
    let surveyViewModal = $('#surveyViewModal');
    let sType = "";
    function isMobile() {
        var userAgentInfo = navigator.userAgent;
        var mobileAgents = ["Android", "iPhone", "SymbianOS", "Windows Phone", "iPad", "iPod"];
        var mobile_flag = false;
        for (var v = 0; v < mobileAgents.length; v++) {
            if (userAgentInfo.indexOf(mobileAgents[v]) > 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        var screen_width = window.screen.width;
        var screen_height = window.screen.height;
        if (screen_width < 500 && screen_height < 800) {
            mobile_flag = true;
        }
        return mobile_flag;
    }
    var SURVEY_KEY = "SURVEY_KEY_ITEM";
    var item = localStorage.getItem(SURVEY_KEY);
    var lastLoginTime = '1787871923000';
    var surveyed = item != null && item === lastLoginTime;

    // if ('' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
    //     getSurvey();
    // }
    var timeoutId = null;
    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }
    timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
        let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
        let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
        if(!flag) return;
        if ('' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
            getSurvey();
        }
    },1500)
    function getSurvey(surveyCode) {
        surveyCodeIn = surveyCode || '';
        $.ajax({
            type: "get",
            url: "/v2/survey/getSurvey?scope=&language=CN&surveyCode=" + surveyCodeIn,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                if (data && data.code === 1){
                    localStorage.setItem(SURVEY_KEY, lastLoginTime);
                }

                if (data.code === 1 && data.data) {
                    data.data.qaUrl?url=data.data.qaUrl:''
                    var survey = data.data;
                    sType = survey.surveyType;
                    $("#surveyId").val(survey.id);
                    if (survey.surveyType === "C") {//单选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "P") {// 多选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle ' + surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        html += '<div><div id="pcheckbox">'
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div class="custom-control custom-checkbox label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input type="checkbox" name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + '   class="custom-control-input pinput" >'
                                +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label plabel">'
                                +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value
                                +
                                '</label></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);

                        $(".plabel").on('click', function (e) { //给label添加事件
                            if ($(".pinput").checked) { //由于点击label的时候，还没有告诉checkbo改变状态，所以当前值是false，执行else语句
                                $(".pinput").checked = false //置为false
                            } else {
                                $(".pinput").checked = true //所以这个时候checkbox应该变成了true，状态改变成功！
                            }
                        });
                    }else if (survey.surveyType === "A") {//问答题
                        $("#surveyContent").html('<div class="survey-inputform-box"><div class="surveyTitle text-center">' + survey.title + '</div><div>' +
                            '<input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input" style="margin:0 auto" required type="text" id="inputAnswer" placeholder="在这里输入答案"/>' +
                            '</div></div>')
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "M") {//复合题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle '+ surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div>';
                                if(items[i].key == 'O'){
                                    html += '<div style="padding-left:28px"><input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input input_otherReason mb-2" required type="text" id="otherReason" placeholder="在这里输入"/></div>';
                                }
                                if(items[i].key == 'Q'){
                                    let form=document.createElement('form')
                                    form.className="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    form.id="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    let content=items[i].content
                                    for (let index = 0; index < content.length; index++) {
                                        const element = content[index];
                                        if(element.type=="text"){
                                          let div=document.createElement("div")
                                          let input=document.createElement("input")
                                          let label=document.createElement("label")
                                          label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                          input.name=element.label
                                          input.placeholder="请输入"
                                          input.required=element.require
                                          input.className="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input mb-2"
                                          div.append(label)
                                          div.append(input)
                                          form.append(div)
                                        }else if(element.type="option"){
                                            if(element.multiple){
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let html=
                                                `<div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <input name="`+element.label+`" value="" `+(element.require?'required':'') +` type="hidden" id="categorys" placeholder="请选择">
                                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <div class="form-control form-control-sm dimension-type category-custorm-css">
                                                        <span class="lable-category">请选择</span>
                                                        <select disabled class="select-category"></select>
                                                        <div class="category-Objbox">
                                                        <div class="category-box">
                                                       
                                                        </div><div class="mb-1 scroll-show-dimension scroll-show-auto" id="category-box-cotent">`
                                                        for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                            const item = element.options[j];
                                                            html+=`
                                                            <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox mr-2 mb-2" >        
                                                                <input value=`+item+` type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input categoryTypesCheck">     
                                                                <label class="custom-control-label font-12">`+item+`</label>   
                                                            </div>`
                                                        }
                                                        html+=`</div><div class="text-center mt-2">
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pt-1 pb-1 add-category">确定</button>
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary ml-5 pt-1 pb-1 clear-category">清除</button></div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>`
                                                div.innerHTML=html
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                form.append(label)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }else{
                                                let select=document.createElement("select")
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                option.textContent="不限"
                                                option.value=""
                                                option.selected=true
                                                select.name=element.label
                                                select.required=element.require
                                                select.placeholder="请选择"
                                                select.className="form-control form-control-sm"
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                select.append(option)
                                                div.append(label)
                                                for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                    const item = element.options[j];
                                                    let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                    option.value=item
                                                    option.selected=false
                                                    option.textContent=item
                                                    select.append(option)
                                                }
                                                div.append(select)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    setTimeout(() => {
                                        $('.itemcc-surveys-box').append(form)
                                    }, 500);
                                }
                               html += '</div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    }
                    surveyViewModal.modal('show');
                    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    // 标记弹窗时间
                    localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                }else{
                    // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
                    canceledSubscriptionModal();
                }
            },
            error: function (data) {
               // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
               canceledSubscriptionModal();
            }
        });
    }
    //选择inputs
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".custom-control-label", function () {
        $(this).parent().find(".custom-control-input").click();
    });
    // 选中其它
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "input.categoryTypesCheck", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("#category001").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "#category001", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("input.categoryTypesCheck").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
        // 确定、清除
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".add-category", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'add');
    return;

    });
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".clear-category", function () {
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'clear');
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".category-custorm-css", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        $(this).addClass('active')
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", function () {
        $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
        return;
    })
    function clearAddSellerNation($this, type) {
            let value = null;
            let dimensionTypesCheckItem = $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').filter(':checked');
            if (type == "add") {
                  let itemArr = [];
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        dimensionTypesCheckItem.each(function (i, el) {
                              itemArr.push($(el).val());
                        });
                        value = itemArr.length > 0 ? itemArr.join(',') : null;
                  }
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        $('#categorys').val(value);
                        $('.lable-category').text(value);
                  } else {
                        $('#categorys').val(null);
                        $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  }
                $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
            } else if (type == "clear") {
                  value = null;
                  $('#categorys').val(value);
                  $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').prop("checked", false);
            }
      }
    $("#submitSurvey").bind('click', function () {
        if (sType == "P") {
            let data_arr = [];
            let check_arr = $('#pcheckbox input[type=checkbox]:checked');
            $.each(check_arr, function () {
                data_arr.push(
                    $(this).val()
                );
            });
            $("#answer").val(data_arr);
        }

        var answer = $("#answer").val();
        if (!answer) {
            alert("您还没有作答哦~");
            return;
        }
        if (answer == 'O') {
            answer = answer + '+' + $("#otherReason").val();
        }
        if(answer=="Q"){
            let form={}
            let validate=true
            $('#input_otherReason_OO :input[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请输入必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            })
            $('#input_otherReason_OO select[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请选择必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            })
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            let arr=$("#input_otherReason_OO").serializeArray()   
            for (let index = 0; index < arr.length; index++) {
                const element = arr[index];
                form[element.name]=element.value
            }
            answer=answer+"+"+JSON.stringify(form)
        }
        $.ajax({
            type: "post",
            url: "/v2/survey/submitAnswer",
            data: {"id": $("#surveyId").val(), "answer": answer, "surveyType": sType},
            cache: false,
            async: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                $('#surveyViewModal').modal('hide');
                // 标记弹窗时间
                localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                if(url){
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL"){
                        swal({
                        title: '提交成功',
                        html: '<div>这次问卷的调查结果随后会发布到“<a class="community-link" href="'+url+'">精灵社区</a>”，</div>想第一时间知道调查结果，就立刻【加入关注】吧~',
                        imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                        imageSize:'70x70',
                        showConfirmButton: true,
                        showCancelButton: true,
                        confirmButtonText: "加入关注",
                        cancelButtonText: "取消",
                        }).then(function(res){
                            if(res.value){
                            $.ajax({
                            type:"put",
                            url: '/bbs/follow-q/'+url.split('/')[url.split('/').length-1],
                            dataType: 'json',
                            contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                            data: JSON.stringify({}),
                            success: function (result) {
                            if(result && result.code == "OK") {
                            }else{
                            createYgtoastError(result.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                                }
                            },
                            error: function (error) {
                                createYgtoastError(error.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                             }
                             })
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }else{
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
                        swal({
                            title: '提交成功',
                            html: '<div>非常非常感谢！我们会基于您的反馈不断改进产品<div>期待您的下次配合',
                            imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                            imageSize:'70x70',
                            showConfirmButton: true
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("input propertychange", "#inputAnswer", function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("click", 'input:radio[name="answerItem"]', function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
        if($(this).val()=="O"){
            $('.input_otherReason').show()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }else if($(this).val()=="Q"){
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').show()
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
        }else{
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }
    });
    surveyViewModal.on("click", ".close", function () {
        surveyViewModal.modal('hide');
        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/survey/close-survey',
            data: {
                id: $("#surveyId").val()
            },
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (obj) {

            },
            error: function () {}
        });
    });
    surveyViewModal.on('hide.bs.modal', function (event) {
        // 标记弹窗时间
        localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
        canceledSubscriptionModal();
    });
    // 无论有无调查问卷都要去继续流程
    function canceledSubscriptionModal(){
        if (surveyCodeIn == "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
            swal({
                title: '取消订阅成功！',
                text: '非常非常感谢！您对卖家精灵的信任与支持，期待与您的下次合作',
                type: 'success',
                showConfirmButton: true
            }).then(function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    window.location.reload()
                }
            });
        }
    }


</script>

<script src="/assets-v2/js/jquery.cookie.js"></script>
<script>
    $(function () {
        var moduleMap = new Map([
            ["/v2/keyword-miner", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-miner/dynamic", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research", "keyword-research"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research-weekly","keyword-research-weekly"],
            ["/v2/keyword-reverse", "keyword-reverse"],
            ["/v2/keyword-checker", "keyword-checker"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/live-search", "live-search"],
            ["/v2/market-research", "market-research"],
            ["/v2/product-research", "product-research"],
        ])

        var selectors = [
            '#form-condition-search .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-keyword-earch .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market]',
            '#form-condition-search a[data-market-id]',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market-id]',
           // '#form-condition-search select[name=monthName]',
            '#form-condition-search button[type=submit]',
            '#form-condition-search .monthName-button'
        ]

        $(selectors.join(",")).on('click', function () {
           
            var uri = `/v2/aba/reverse/search`;            
            if (moduleMap.has(uri)) {
                $.cookie("module-station-" + moduleMap.get(uri), $(this).attr('data-market') || $(this).attr('data-market-id'), {
                    path: moduleMap.get(uri) === 'keyword-miner' ? '/v2/keyword-miner' : uri,
                    expires: 365,
                });
                if (uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup' || uri === '/v2/product-research' || uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly' || uri === '/v2/market-research'){
                    $.cookie("module-table-" + moduleMap.get(uri),
                        $('#form-condition-search').find('select[name=monthName] option:selected').val() || $(this).attr('data-month-id'), {
                        path: uri,
                        expires: 365
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    })

           <div class="td d-flex align-items-center caname-item">

                {{else}}

                {{/if}}
           </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                    ${getStatonName(vo.station)}
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                {{= vo.count}}
            </div>

        <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">

                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-custom-save pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item"  ${(i==0 && vo.id!='newAdd')|| (i==0 && vo.id =='newAdd')?'':'disabled'}><span class="iconfont icon-correct mr-1"></span>保存</button>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}

</script>

<script>
    $(function () {
        var Fn = {
            node: {
                $body: $("body"),
                $customCategory: $("#my-custom-category"),
                $categoryBody: $("#category-body"),
                globleStation: 'COM',
                asins: [],
                newListAdd:false,
                usestatic:"M",
                batchName:null,
                staticM:'',
                usesWeekly:null,//周数据标识
            },
            init: function () {
                var that = this;
                that.node.globleStation = "US";
                that.node.usestatic = $("input[name=usestatic]").val();
                that.node.batchName = $("input[name=batchName]")?$("input[name=batchName]").val():null;
                that.node.$customCategory.find(".title-box").text(that.node.usestatic=="M"?that.node.batchName?"加入到关键词清单":"加入到关键词清单-关键词挖掘":"加入到关键词清单-关键词选品");
                that.node.staticM = $("input[name=staticM]").val()?$("input[name=staticM]").val():'';
                that.node.usesWeekly = $("input[name='usesWeekly']").val() || null; 
                that.node.$body.on("click", ".add-asins-btns", function () {
                    Fn.showCateDepPop($(this));
                    return;
                });
                that.node.$customCategory.on("click", ".caname-item", function () {
                    Fn.changeItemName($(this));
                    return false;
                })
                that.node.$customCategory.on("click", ".add-category-btn", function () {
                    Fn.addItemtd($(this));
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$categoryBody.on("change", ".custom-label-box", function () {
                    that.node.$categoryBody.find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", true);
                    $(this).parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", false);
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$categoryBody.on("click", ".btn-custom-save", function () {
                    Fn.saveCategoryAll($(this));
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$customCategory.on('click', '.u-modal-window__close', function () {
                    //展示弹窗
                    Fn.hideCatePop();
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$body.on("change", ".select-all-list", function () {
                    let isTrue = $(this).prop('checked');
                    $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]").prop("checked", isTrue);
                    $("input.select-all-list[type=checkbox]").prop("checked", isTrue);
                    return false;
                });
                $(".table-responsive-md").on("change", "input[data-keyword]", function () {
                    let isTrue = $(this).prop('checked'), boxCklen = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked").length, boxAlllen = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]").length;
                    let showAllTrue = false;
                    $(this).prop("checked", isTrue);
                    if (boxCklen < boxAlllen) {
                        showAllTrue = false
                    } else if (boxCklen == boxAlllen) {
                        showAllTrue = true
                    }
                    $("input.select-all-list[type=checkbox]").prop("checked", showAllTrue);
                    return false;
                });
                // that.node.$body.on("click", ".custom-mode-btn", function () {
                //     $(this).addClass("tip-btn-hide");
                //     that.node.$body.find(".category-checkbox-opcity").css("opacity", 1).end().find(".category-checkbox-tip").removeClass("tip-btn-hide");
                //     return false;
                // });
            },
            loadCustomDepList: function () {
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'get',
                    url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/listAll',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    data:{
                        use:Fn.node.usestatic//M=挖掘/R=选品
                    },
                    success: function (result) {
                        let customListList = [];
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            customListList = result.data;
                        }
                        Fn.node.$categoryBody.html($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: customListList }));
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        Fn.node.$categoryBody.html($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: [] }));
                    }
                });
            },
            changeItemName: function ($this) {
                let td = $this.find(">span"), id = $this.find(">span").attr("data-id");
                let txt = id == "new" ? td.html() : td.text();
                let input = $("<input type='text' value='' class='item-inputs form-control' maxlength='150' required autocomplete='off'/>");
                id == "new" ? td.find(".icon-label-compile").attr('data-original-title', '').tooltip('hide') : "";
                td.addClass("transparent-bottom-color").html(input)
                input.click(function () { return false; });
                //获取焦点
                input.trigger("focus").val(id == "new" ? "" : txt);
                //文本框失去焦点后提交内容，重新变为文本
                input.blur(function () {Fn.blurKeydownInput($(this),td,txt,id)});
                input.bind('keypress',function(event){
                    if(event.keyCode == "13")    
                    {
                        Fn.blurKeydownInput($(this),td,txt,id)
                    }
                });   
            },
            blurKeydownInput: function($this,td,txt,id){
                    let newtxt = $.trim($this.val());
                    let $inputs = $this;
                    //判断文本有没有修改
                    if (newtxt != txt && newtxt != "") {
                        let dataNewTxt = { name: newtxt,use:Fn.node.usestatic}
                        // if(that.node.usesWeekly){
                        //     dataNewTxt.weekly = 'Y'
                        // }
                        if (id == "new") {
                            dataNewTxt.station = Fn.node.globleStation;
                            $.ajax({
                                type: 'post',
                                url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/add',
                                data: dataNewTxt, //M=挖掘/R=选品 
                                dataType: 'json',
                                success: function (result) {
                                    Fn.disposeDepartment(result, td, $inputs, txt);
                                },
                                error: function (e) {
                                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            dataNewTxt.station = id;
                            dataNewTxt.id = id;
                            $.ajax({
                                type: 'post',
                                url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/edit',
                                data: dataNewTxt, //M=挖掘/R=选品 
                                dataType: 'json',
                                success: function (result) {
                                    Fn.disposeDepartment(result, td, $inputs, txt);
                                },
                                error: function (e) {
                                     Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        td.removeClass("transparent-bottom-color").html(txt);
                    }
                
            },
            //处理数据
            disposeDepartment: function (result, $td, $inputs, txt) {
                if (result.code == "OK") {
                    if (result.data) {
                        $td.attr("data-id", result.data);
                        $td.parents("tr").addClass("category-list-tr").attr("data-trid", result.data).removeClass("new-add-list");
                    }
                    $td.removeClass("transparent-bottom-color").html($inputs.val());
                    if(Fn.node.newListAdd){Fn.saveCategoryAll($td.parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save"))}
                } else {
                    $inputs.attr('title', '').attr('data-original-title', result.message).tooltip('show').trigger("focus");
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        $inputs.tooltip('hide')
                    }, 3000);
                    if($(".btn-custom-save:not(:disabled)").length==0){$td.parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", false)}
                    Fn.node.newListAdd=false;
                }

            },
            addItemtd: function () {
                let listId = $("tr.new-add-list"), nodataList = $("#category-body tr.nodata-tr"), allList = $("#category-body tr.category-list-tr");
                let nowDate = new Date();
                let isloadingTr = $("#category-body tr.no-data-loading");
                isloadingTr.length>0?isloadingTr.remove():"";
                if (listId.length == 0) {
                    nodataList.length > 0 ? nodataList.remove() : Fn.node.$categoryBody.find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled",true);
                    Fn.node.$categoryBody.prepend($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: [{ id: "newAdd", trnew: listId, count: 0, station: Fn.node.globleStation, createdTime: nowDate, allList: allList.length }] }))
                    Fn.node.$categoryBody.find(".new-add-list .caname-item").trigger("click");
                } else {
                    Fn.showInputsTips("您还没有填写/保存清单名称！")
                }

            },
            showInputsTips: function (message) {
                $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('title', '').attr('data-original-title', message).tooltip('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('data-original-title', '').tooltip('hide');
                }, 2000);
            },
            saveCategoryAll: function ($this) {
                let listId = $this.parents("tr").attr("data-trid"),that = this, itemStation = $this.parents("tr").attr("data-station");
                if (itemStation != "US") {
                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: "注意清单列表的站点必须与关键词清单站点一致！" });
                    return;
                }
                if(listId==""){return}
                if ((listId != ""&&listId == "newAdd")) {
                    if($this.parents("tr").find(".icon-label-compile").length==0){
                        Fn.node.newListAdd =true;
                    }else{
                        Fn.showInputsTips("您还没有填写/保存清单名称！")
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if($this.parents("tr").find(".item-inputs").length!=0){Fn.node.newListAdd
                return;}
                $this.prop("disabled", true);
                let addKeywordsData = {
                        id: listId,
                        station: itemStation,
                        keywords: Fn.node.asins
                    }
                if(that.node.usesWeekly){
                    addKeywordsData.weekly = 'Y'
                }
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'post',
                    url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/addKeywords',
                    data: addKeywordsData,
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        $this.prop("disabled", false);
                        Fn.node.newListAdd=false;
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            Fn.hideCatePop();
                            Swal.fire({
                                title: '添加成功！', //标题
                                html: '<span style="color: #66BC38"> '+(that.node.usestatic=="M"?"关键词清单入口在关键词挖掘右上角，是否立即去查看？": "已成功加入“关键词选品清单”，是否立即查看呢？")+'</span>',
                                textColor: '#66BC38',
                                imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                                imageSize: '70x70',
                                confirmButtonColor: '#FB8C1E',
                                confirmButtonText: '立即查看',
                                showCancelButton: true,
                                cancelButtonColor: '#CFD2D6',
                                cancelButtonText: "关闭窗口",
                                focusCancel: true,
                            }).then((isConfirm) => {
                                try {
                                    //判断 是否 点击的 确定按钮
                                    if (isConfirm.value) {
                                        window.open('/v2/keyword-inventory/list?type='+Fn.node.usestatic)
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        window.location.reload(true);
                                    }
                                } catch (e) {
                                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e, imageUrl: "" })
                                }
                            });
                        }

                    },
                    error: function (e) {
                        $this.prop("disabled", false);
                        Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message, imageUrl: "" })
                    }
                });
            },
            showCateDepPop: function ($this) {
                $this.prop("disabled", true);
                let _$asinList = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked");
                let loading = '<tr class="no-data-loading"><td colspan="6"><div class="pt-4 text-center"><img src="/assets/images/admin-loading.gif" alt="" width="32"></div></td></tr>'
                Fn.node.asins = [];
                Fn.node.$categoryBody.html(loading)
                if (_$asinList.length > 0) _$asinList.each(function () {
                    // console.log($(this));
                    if(!$(this)[0].disabled){
                        let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                        keyword?Fn.node.asins.push(keyword) : null; 
                    }
                });
                if (Fn.node.asins.length < 1) {
                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: "请选择您想要加入关键词清单的列表！" })
                } else {
                    Fn.loadCustomDepList();
                    Fn.node.$customCategory.modal();
                }
                $this.prop("disabled", false);

            },
            showTipPop: function (params) {
                swal({
                    title: params.title ? params.title : '温馨提示',
                    text: params.text?params.text:'主人，请求太过频繁，网络不稳定，请稍后重试！',
                    imageUrl: params.imageUrl ? params.imageUrl : '../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                    imageSize: '70x70',
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                });
            },
            hideCatePop: function () {
                Fn.node.$customCategory.modal('hide');
            },

        }
        Fn.init();
    });
    function getStatonName(code) {
        let stationList = JSON.parse('[{"country":"United ry":"Brazil","website":"https://www.amazon.com.br","code":"BR","marketplace":"A2Q3Y263D00KWC","areas":["BR"],"publicCode":"BR","label":"巴西站(br)","shortname":"巴","marketId":15,"countryCode":"BR","online":false,"currency":"R$","currencyCode":"BRL"},{"country":"Australia","website":"https://www.amazon.com.au","code":"AU","marketplace":"A39IBJ37TRP1C6","areas":["AU"],"publicCode":"AU","label":"澳大利亚(au)","shortname":"澳","marketId":111172,"countryCode":"AU","online":false,"currency":"A$","currencyCode":"AUD"},{"country":"United stationName = "";
        $.each(stationList, function (i, item) {
            if (code == item.publicCode) {
                stationName = item.label;
                return false
            }
        });
        return stationName.split("(")[0]

    }

                title: '温馨提示',

                showConfirmButton: true,
                confirmButtonText:'确定',
                language_name: 'cn',

            $('.keywords-comparison').trigger('click');

<script id="container-goods-asin-info-tmpl" type="text/html">
        <div class="row mr-3">
            <div class="col-12">
                <div class="media d-flex align-items-center">
                    <div class="u-avatar">
                        <div class="set-background">
                            <img class="u-avatar" src="{{= (asinInfo&&asinInfo.imageUrl)?asinInfo.imageUrl:'../../../assets-v2/img/image_loading_cn.png'}}" onerror="javascript:this.src='../../../assets-v2/img/image_loadfail_cn.png';">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="media-body ml-5 max-width-80">
                        <div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between">
                            <div class="mb-2 text-truncate titileW">{{= (asinInfo&&asinInfo.title)?asinInfo.title:'--'}}</div>
                        </div>
                        <!-- bsr等基础字段信息展示 -->
                        <div style="width:100%">
                            <div id="module-table-info" class="pop-data-d d-flex align-items-center" >
                                <div class="mr-4">                     
                                    {{if station&&asinInfo&&asinInfo.asin}}
                                    <span class="flag-icon flag-icon-${station.toLowerCase()} mr-2"></span>
                                    <span class="text-primary">{{= asinInfo&&asinInfo.asin?asinInfo.asin:'--'}}</span>
                                    {{/if}}                  
                                    <a class="link-muted no-decoration lighter" href="{{= website}}/dp/{{= asinInfo.asin}}?psc=1" target="_blank"><span class="iconfont icon-to_amazon small ml-1" data-toggle="tooltip" title="去亚马逊查看该ASIN"></span></a>                 
                                </div>
                                <p class="pop-data-p mb-0">
                                    BSR排名: <span class="pop-data-s"> ${asinInfo.bsrRank && asinInfo.bsrRank > 0 ?  Customer.commafy(asinInfo.bsrRank,0) : '--' }</span>
                                </p>
                                <p class="pop-data-p mb-0">
                                    价格:
                                    {{if asinInfo.price}}

                                        {{if station.toUpperCase() == 'JP'}}
                                            <span class="pop-data-s">{{= asinInfo.price}}円</span>
                                        {{else}}
                                            <span class="pop-data-s">{{= currency}}{{= asinInfo.price}}</span>
                                        {{/if}}
                                    {{else}}
                                    <span class="mr-4">--</span>
                                    {{/if}}
                                </p>
                                <p class="pop-data-p mb-0">
                                    评分数: <span class="pop-data-s"> ${ asinInfo.reviews ? Customer.commafy(asinInfo.reviews,0) : '--' }</span>
                                </p>
                                <p class="pop-data-p mb-0">
                                    Q&A数: <span class="pop-data-s">{{= asinInfo.questions ? asinInfo.questions : '--'}}</span>
                                </p>
                                <p class="pop-data-p mb-0">
                                    上架时间: 
                                    {{if asinInfo.availableDate}}
                                    <span class="pop-data-s"> ${moment(asinInfo.availableDate).format('YYYY-MM-DD')}</span>
                                    {{else}}
                                    <span class="mr-4">--</span>
                                    {{/if}}
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
</script>

<script id="container-trend-sales-tmpl" type="text/html">

font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal;                         <tr>

                                    {{if station&&station=='JAPAN'}}
