<script>
    window.ppcLang = 'cn'
    function getShowOldPpc() {
        var isMonth = $('#reverseMonthly').val() == 'M';
        var month = $('#form-condition-search input[name="monthlyTable"]').val();
        var weekDate = $('#form-condition-search input[name="table"]').val();
        return (isMonth && (month < 'ara_202508')) || (!isMonth && (weekDate < 'ara_20250802'));
    }

    var tips = '导出该产品的所有关键词'
    if ("com.iyunya.rank.dao.vo.ClientSearchVO@354884e0" === "" || ("S" === "G" && "N" !== "Y")){
        tips = '您是免费用户，<a href="/cn/price" style="border-bottom:1px dashed #FB8C1E" target="_blank">升级套餐</a>后即可导出';
        $('#list-export-reverse').attr('data-tips', tips)
        $('#list-export-reverse').attr('disabled',true);
    }else{
        $('#list-export-reverse').attr('data-tips', tips)
    }



    function openKeywordStore(a){
        if(a == 'all'){
            let _$keywordList= $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked")
            var form = document.getElementById("form-condition-search");
            $('#search-asin').val($('#search-dto-asin').val());
            $('#input-textarea-value').removeAttr('name');
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            var jsonData = {};
            for (var [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
                jsonData[key] = value;
            }
            let keywordList=[]
            $('#search-asin').val('');
            $('#input-textarea-value').attr('name', 'textareaValue');
            _$keywordList.each(function () {
                    let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                    keyword?keywordList.push(keyword) : null; 
                });
            setTimeout(() => {
                $('.keyword-store-href').click()
            }, 100);
            // console.log(jsonData,'jsonData');
            allKeywordStoreData('COM',keywordList,'RS',true,jsonData)
        }else{
            let _$keywordList= $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked")
            if(_$keywordList.length<1){
                swal({
                    title: '温馨提示',
                    text:'请至少选择一个关键词',
                    imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                    imageSize: '70x70',
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                    });
            }else{
                let keywordList=[]
                let keywordIdList = []
                _$keywordList.each(function () {
                        let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                        keyword?keywordList.push(keyword) : null; 
                    });
                setTimeout(() => {
                    $('.keyword-store-href').click()
                }, 100);
                initKeywordStoreData('COM',keywordList)
            }
        }
    }
    function dataPickWeeklyData(data){
        let netDataYear = moment(data, 'YYYYMMDD').subtract('days', 6);
        let netData =  moment(data, 'YYYYMMDD');
        let week = netData.format('W');
        let newDataString = netData.format('YYYY') + '第' + (week.length == 1?('0' + week):week) + '周' + netDataYear.format('(MM/DD') + '~' + netData.format('MM/DD)') + ' ';
        return newDataString;
    }
    function dataPickMonthlyData(data){
        return data.substring(0,4) + '-' + data.substring(4,6);
    }
    // 处理站点月份类目数据2.0
    var GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS = null;
    var GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS_MONTHLY = null;
    function handleMakertsTablesDepartments(){
        var jsonStr = $('#data-json-markets-tables-departments').html().trim();
        var monthStr = $('#data-json-markets-tables-departments-monthly').html().trim();

        if(jsonStr){
            GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        }
        if(monthStr){
            GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS_MONTHLY = JSON.parse(monthStr);
        }
        // console.log(jsonStr);
    }
    handleMakertsTablesDepartments();
    function getTablesDepartmentsByStation(station){
        var tablesDepartmentsObj = null;
        if(GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS){
            for(var i=0;i<GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS.length;i++){
                var obj = GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS[i]
                if(obj){
                    var market = obj['station'];
                    if(market['publicCode'] == station || market['code'] == station || ('' +market['id']) == station){
                        tablesDepartmentsObj = obj;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return tablesDepartmentsObj;
    }
    function getTablesDepartmentsByStationMonthly(station){
        var tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly = null;
        if(GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS_MONTHLY){
            for(var i=0;i<GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS_MONTHLY.length;i++){
                var obj = GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS_MONTHLY[i]
                if(obj){
                    var market = obj['station'];
                    if(market['publicCode'] == station || market['code'] == station || ('' +market['id']) == station){
                        tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly = obj;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly;
    }
    //加载可查询的月份列表2.0
    function loadDocuments(table,$this){
        var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
        var station = $form.find('input[name="station"]').val();
        var tablesDepartmentsObj = getTablesDepartmentsByStation(station);
        var tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly = getTablesDepartmentsByStationMonthly(station);
        // console.log(tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly);
        let checkDate = $('#reverseDropdownMenuButton').attr('data-date');//选中的值
        if(tablesDepartmentsObj){
            data = tablesDepartmentsObj['tables'];
            // // js处理历史日期
            let historyDate = $('#form-condition-search input[name=table]').val();
            for(var i=0;i<data.length;i++){
                var tableVO = data[i];
                var tb = tableVO['table'];
                // 周
                // 高亮选中的值
                if(tb == checkDate || tb == historyDate){
                    var c =`<a class="dropdown-item active" href="javascript:;" data-date="`+tb+`">`+ dataPickWeeklyData(tableVO['label'])+`</a>`

                }else{
                    var c =`<a class="dropdown-item" href="javascript:;" data-date="`+tb+`">`+ dataPickWeeklyData(tableVO['label']) +`</a>`
                }
                $('.date-group-week .reverse-dropdown-menu').append(c)
            }
        }
    };
    function loadDocumentsMonthly(table,$this){
        var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
        var station = $form.find('input[name="station"]').val();
        var tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly = getTablesDepartmentsByStationMonthly(station);
        let checkDate = $('#reverseDropdownMenuButtonMonth').attr('data-date');//选中的值
        if(tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly){
            data = tablesDepartmentsObjMonthly['tables'];
            // // js处理历史日期
            let historyDate = $('#form-condition-search input[name=monthlyTable]').val();
            // console.log(historyDate,'historyDate');
            for(var i=0;i<data.length;i++){
                var tableVO = data[i];
                var tb = tableVO['table'];
                // 高亮选中的值
                if(tb == checkDate || tb == historyDate){
                    var c =`<a class="dropdown-item active" href="javascript:;" data-date="`+tb+`">`+ dataPickMonthlyData(tableVO['label']) +`</a>`

                }else{
                    var c =`<a class="dropdown-item" href="javascript:;" data-date="`+tb+`">`+ dataPickMonthlyData(tableVO['label']) +`</a>`
                }
                $('.date-group-month .reverse-dropdown-menu').append(c)
            }
        }
    };
    // 加载到就执行一次2.0
    loadDocuments('ara_20260822');
    loadDocumentsMonthly('{$dto.table}')
    function resetClick() {
        $('#form-condition-search').find("input[data-item=asins]").val('');
        return;
    }
    function doSearch() {
        var station = $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val();
        var that = $('#form-condition-search');
        var keys = that.find('input[data-item=asins]').val();
        $('#form-condition-search').submit();
        return false
    }
    function abaFormOnSubmit(){
        // loading
        $('#loading-content').css('color','#fb8c1e')
        $('#loading-content').attr('disabled',true)
        setTimeout(function () {
                  $('#reverse-loading').removeClass('vertions-hide')
        }, 200);
    }
    function fListenMarket() {
        $('#form-condition-search a[data-market]').click(function () {
            var m = $(this).attr('data-market'), $v = $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]');
            $v.val(m);
           var dataType=$('#form-condition-search #reverseMonthly').val();
            $('.date-group-week .reverse-dropdown-menu').empty()
            loadDocuments()
            $('.date-group-month .reverse-dropdown-menu').empty()
            loadDocumentsMonthly()
            if( dataType== 'W'){//周
                $('.date-group-week .reverse-dropdown-menu-week .dropdown-item')[0].click()
            }else{//月
                $('.date-group-month .reverse-dropdown-menu-month .dropdown-item')[0].click()
            }
            $('#form-condition-search .station-publicCode[data-toggle=dropdown]').html($(this).html());
        });
        $('[data-tips]').each(tips_popover);
    }
    function showTextareaMessage(message){
        var that = $('#form-condition-search');
        var $sms = that.find('input[data-item=asins]');
        $sms.attr('title', message).attr('data-original-title', message).tooltip('show');
        setTimeout(function () {
            $sms.attr('data-original-title', '')
        }, 3000);
    }
    function checkParam(){
        var that = $('#form-condition-search');
        var station = $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val();
        if (!station) {
            station = 'US';
            $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val(station);
        }
        var keys = that.find('input[data-item=asins]').val();
        if (keys.trim() === '') {
            showTextareaMessage("请输入需要检索的ASIN")
            return false;
        }
        var keyWordCollection = keys.split(/[(\r\n)\r\n]+/).filter(function (n) {
            return n !== ''
        });
        var value = $('#form-condition-search input[name=guestVisited]').val();
        var admin = value !== "false";
        if (!admin && keyWordCollection.length > 20) {
            showTextareaMessage("抱歉，最多只能检索20个ASIN");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    jQuery(function($) {
        fListenMarket();
        $('#search-click-btn').unbind('click').click(function () {
            if(checkParam()) doSearch();
        });
        // 周月选择
        $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-data-type').on('click', '.dropdown-item', function (e) {
            $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-data-type .dropdown-item').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');
            var m = $(this).attr('data-type');
            $('#form-condition-search #reverseMonthly').val(m);
            $('#reverse-dropdown-date-type').attr('data-type',m);
            $('#reverse-dropdown-date-type').text($(this).text());
            if(m == 'W'){//周
                $('.date-group-month').addClass('vertions-hide');
                $('.date-group-week').removeClass('vertions-hide');
            }else{//月
                $('.date-group-week').addClass('vertions-hide');
                $('.date-group-month').removeClass('vertions-hide');
            }
        });
        // 历史月份选择2.0
        $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-week').on('click', '.dropdown-item', function (e) {
            $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-week .dropdown-item').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');
            var m = $(this).attr('data-date');
            $('#form-condition-search input[name=table]').val(m);
            $('#reverseDropdownMenuButton').attr('data-date',m);
            $('#reverseDropdownMenuButton').text($(this).text());
        });
        $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-month').on('click', '.dropdown-item', function (e) {
            $('.reverse-dropdown-menu-month .dropdown-item').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');
            var m = $(this).attr('data-date');
            $('#form-condition-search input[name=monthlyTable]').val(m);
            $('#reverseDropdownMenuButtonMonth').attr('data-date',m);
            $('#reverseDropdownMenuButtonMonth').text($(this).text());
        });
        // 示例点击
        $('#example-box').on('click','a',function(){
            // console.log($(this).text());
            let asin = $(this).text();
            $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val('US');
            $('input[name=textareaValue]').val(asin);
            if(checkParam()) doSearch();
        })
        
        // 上传txt批量查询事件
        var showUploadTxtError = function(){
            swal({
                title: '操作失败',
                text:'文件上传失败，请稍后重试！',
                type:'error'
            });
        };
        var uploadTxtBatchQuery = function(){
            if(!document.querySelector("#reverse-file")){
                return false;
            }
            document.querySelector("#reverse-file").addEventListener("change",function () {
                //获取到选中的文件
                var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
                var file = document.querySelector("#reverse-file").files[0];
                $('input[name=textareaValue]').val('');
                $('#reverse-file').attr('name','file');
                // $('#reverse-file').val(file);
                $form.attr('enctype','multipart/form-data');
                $form.attr('method', 'post');
                // console.log(file);
                if(file) doSearch();
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $form.attr('method', 'get');
                    $('#reverse-file').removeAttr('name')
                    $form.removeAttr('enctype')
                    $('#reverse-file').val('');
                }, 200);
            });
        }
        // uploadTxtBatchQuery();
        window.ModuleKeywordsTrend.on();//初始化图表
        window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.init('CN');//点击集中度
        window.ModuleHistoryKepaTrends.init('CN');//keepa
    });
    function numFormat(num) {
        var c = (num.toString().indexOf('.') !== -1) ? num.toLocaleString() : num.toString().replace(
            /(\d)(?=(?:\d{3})+$)/g, '$1,');
        return c;
    }

    // 加载全部数据
    function addAllData(){
        $(".lhy-addMore").hide()
        $(".lhy-loading").show()
        $.ajax({
            url: "/v2/aba/reverse/search/more?station=US&table=ara_20260822" + "&monthlyTable=ara_202607"
                + "&asin=B06XZTZ7GB&order.field=searchRank&reverseType=" + $("#reverseMonthly").val()
                + "&order.desc=true&conversionType=&loadVariations=true",
            dataType:"json",
            type:"GET",
            success:function(res){
                if(!res || !res.data || !res.data.items || res.data.items.length == 0){
                    $(".lhy-more").hide()
                    $(".lhy-no-more").show()
                    return false
                }
                var reverseingItems = res.data.items
                reverseingItems = reverseingItems.map(function(item){
                    // 去亚马逊搜索链接
                    item.gotoAmazonLink = item.station.website + '/s?k=' + item.keyword.replace("&", "%26")
                    // 渲染 echarts 图表数据
                    let thumbTrend = item.thumbTrend ? item.thumbTrend : []
                    let thumbTrendList = thumbTrend.map(t => {
                        return {
                            x: t.flag,
                            y: t.value,
                            valueLast: t.valueLast,
                            valueGrowth: t.valueGrowth,
                            growthRate: t.growthRate
                        }
                    })
                    let searchRankTrend = item.searchRankTrend ? item.searchRankTrend : []
                    let searchRankTrendList = searchRankTrend.map(s => {
                        return {
                            x: s.flag,
                            y: s.value,
                            valueLast: s.valueLast,
                            valueGrowth: s.valueGrowth,
                            growthRate: s.growthRate
                        }
                    })
                    item.thumbTrendList = JSON.stringify(thumbTrendList)
                    item.searchRankTrendList = JSON.stringify(searchRankTrendList)
                    // 只展示点击前三的产品图片
                    if(item.monopolyAsinDtos && item.monopolyAsinDtos.length > 3){
                        item.monopolyAsinDtos = item.monopolyAsinDtos.slice(0,3)
                    }
                    // 只展示关键词前十的产品图片
                    if(item.gkDatas){
                        if(item.gkDatas.length > 10){
                            item.gkDatas = item.gkDatas.slice(0,10)
                        }
                        item.gkDatas= item.gkDatas.map(d => {
                            d.gotoAmazonLink = item.station.website + '/dp/' + d.asin + '?psc=1'
                            return d
                        })
                    }
                    return item
                })
                $('#table-condition-search tbody').append($('#tmpl_reversing_words_tbody_tr').tmpl({reverseingItems: reverseingItems}))
                $(".lhy-more").hide()
                $("#lhy-no-more").show()
                // 为新加载的数据绑定 管理员编辑、保存事件
                saveBtnEv()
                showEdit()
                // 复制到剪切板 - 当前页面所有关键词
                copyAllKeywords();
                // 去除温馨提示
                if($("#warmTips")){
                    $("#warmTips").hide()
                }

                $("[data-toggle='tooltip']").tooltip();
                $('[data-tips]').each(tips_popover);
                window.ModuleKeywordsTrend.addEvent();
            } 
        })  
    }

        function saveBtnEv(){
            $(".editTranslation").on("click",'.save-btn-event',function () {
                let param = {
                    'station':$("input[name='station']").val(),
                    'keywords':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywords-save').val(),
                    'keywordCn':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywordCn-val').val()
                };
                $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',true);
                let _this = $(this);
                $.ajax({
                    type: "post",
                    url: "/v2/keyword/updateTranslation",
                    data: param,
                    cache: false,
                    async: false,
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function (data) {
                        $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',false);
                        if (data.error){
                            alert(data.error);
                        }else {
                            // window.location.replace(location.href);   
                            _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.span-keywords-transport').text(param.keywordCn);
                            _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
        
        }
        function showEdit(){
            $('.edit-translation').on('click','.edit-btn-event',function(){
                $('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
                $(this).parent('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","inline")
            })
        }

      // 复制到剪切板 - 当前页面所有关键词
      function copyAllKeywords() {
            var copied_keywords = [], _total = [];
            $('.u-datatable table tbody tr>td:nth-child(3) .span-keywords').each(function () {
                  _total.push($.trim($(this).attr('data-keyword')))
            });
            for (var k in _total) {
                  _total[k] && _total[k] != '' && _total[k].indexOf('XX') == -1 && copied_keywords.indexOf(_total[k]) === -1 && copied_keywords.push(_total[k]);
            }
            //复制页面关键词
            var clipboard = new ClipboardJS('[data-clipboard-reverse]', {
                  text: function (trigger) {
                        return copied_keywords.join('\r\n');
                  }
            });
            let copyText = '已复制到剪贴板'
            switch (window.GLOBAL_MOMENT_LANGUAGE) {
                  case 'en':
                        copyText = 'Copied Successfully'
                        break;
                  case 'jp':
                        copyText = 'クリップボードにコピーした'
                        break;
                  default:
                        copyText = '已复制到剪贴板'
                        break;
            }
            clipboard.on('success', function (e) {
                  var $sms = $(e.trigger);
                  $sms.attr('title', copyText).attr('data-content', copyText).popover('show');
                  setTimeout(function () { $sms.attr('data-content', '') }, 1000);
            });
            var clipboardTitle = new ClipboardJS('[data-clipboard-title-reverse]', {
                  text: function (trigger) {
                        var txt = $(trigger).attr('data-clipboard-title-reverse')
                        return txt;
                  }
            });
            clipboardTitle.on('success', function (e) {
                  var $sms = $(e.trigger);
                  var tips = $sms.attr('data-original-title');
                  $sms.attr('data-original-title', copyText);
                  $sms.tooltip('show');
                  setTimeout(function () {
                        $sms.attr('data-original-title', tips);
                  }, 1000);

            });

      };

    $('#btn-query-history').bind('click', function(){
        loadQueryHistoryLogs();
        window.getAccount.getAccount()
    });

    //查询历史
    function loadQueryHistoryLogs(page,id){
        if(!page) page = 1;
        if(!id) id='';
        page = parseInt(page,10);
        page = page - 1;
        var pageSize = 20;
        $('#querylog-pg-nv').html('');
        $.ajax({
            type: "post",
            url: "/v2/query-log/history",
            data:{"startIndex":pageSize * page,"module":'KWA',"terminal": 'W',familyClientId:id},
            cache:false,
            async:false,
            dataType: "json",
            beforeSend: function () {
                $('#querylog-tbody').html($('#querylog-tbody-loading').tmpl({}));
                $('#querylog-op-tbody').hide();
            }
        }).then(function (ajaxData) {
            $('#querylog-tbody-loading').hide();
            $('#querylog-tbody').html('');
            if(ajaxData && ajaxData.code=="OK" && ajaxData.data){
                //查询无结果
                if(!ajaxData.data.items || ajaxData.data.items.length <= 0){
                    $('#querylog-tbody').html($('#querylog-tbody-noitem-tmp').tmpl({}));
                    $('#querylog-op-tbody').hide();
                    return;
                }
                $('#querylog-tbody').html($('#querylog-tbody-tmp').tmpl({pg:ajaxData.data}));
                $('#querylog-pg-nv').html($('#querylog-pg-nv-tmp').tmpl({pg:ajaxData.data}));
                $('#querylog-op-tbody').show();
                $('#querylog-tbody').find(".movement-item").tooltip('show').tooltip('hide');
                //tooltip
                $('[data-tips]').each(tips_popover);
                //分页按钮点击事件
                $('#querylog-pg-nv').find('.page-item').unbind('click').bind('click', function(){
                    var page = $(this).attr('data-page');
                    loadQueryHistoryLogs(page,id);
                });
            }else{
                swal({
                    title: '操作失败',
                    text:'查询历史获取失败，请稍后再试！',
                    type:'error'
                });
            }

        })
    }

</script>

                                  >
                                  <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="item-text-black pr-4 show-monopoly-trends show-goods-asins"
                                    data-original-title="点击图片，查看点击、转化占比趋势" 
                                    data-toggle="tooltip" 
                                    data-asin="{{= dto.asin}}" 
                                    data-keyword="{{= item.keyword}}"
                                    data-website ="{{= item.station.website}}"
                                    data-station="{{= item.station.code}}"
                                    data-gv="{{= item.guestVisited}}" 
                                    pop-type="click_point"
                                    data-countryCode="{{= item.station.countryCode}}"
                                    data-currency="{{= item.station.currency}}">
                                     <div class="bg-white">
                                         <div class="preset-background">
                                             <div class="popover-imgs position-relative"
                                                  style="background-image: url('{{= dto.image_url || '/assets-v2/img/keyword-miner-preview-cn.png'}}')" >
                                             </div>
                                         </div>
                                     </div>
                                  </a>
                                 </div>
                        {{/each}}
                    {{/if}}
                     </div>
                    </div>
                 </td>
           
                
                {{if !item.guestVisited}}
                <td class="align-middle pr-4 text-center text-primary text-primary-hb">
                    <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="show-monopoly-trends"
                                data-keyword="{{= item.keyword}}"
                                data-station="{= item.station.code}}"
                                data-gv="{{= item.guestVisited}}"
                                data-countryCode="{{= item.station.countryCode}}"
                                data-currency="{{= item.station.currency}}"
                                data-original-title="查看该关键词的历史走势"
                                pop-type="search"
                                data-toggle="tooltip"
                    ><span class="iconfont icon-historical-trend"></span></a>
                    <br/>
                    <a href="javascript:" class="show-monopoly-trends d-inline-block mt-3"
                       data-original-title="查看该关键词的Google Trends图" 
                       data-toggle="tooltip"
                       pop-type="google" 
                       data-gv="{{= item.guestVisited}}" 
                       data-station="{{= item.station.code}}" 
                       data-currency="{{= item.station.currency}}" 
                       data-countryCode="{{= item.station.countryCode}}"
                       data-keyword="{{= item.keyword}}">
                       <span class="iconfont icon-google-trends-icon"></span></a>
                </td>
                {{else}}
                <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 text-center text-muted">
                <a href="javascript:void(0)" class="text-muted gv-btn"
                                data-toggle="tooltip"
                                title="付费后可见~"
                    ><span class="iconfont icon-historical-trend"></span></a>
                    <br/>
                    <a href="javascript:" class="text-muted gv-btn d-inline-block mt-3"
                       data-original-title="付费后可见~" 
                       data-toggle="tooltip">
                       <span class="iconfont icon-google-trends-icon"></span></a>
                </td>
                {{/if}}
                </tr>
    {{/each}}
</script>

</body>
</html>
